list.title: Content
list.intro: Help, legal pages and other pages in four languages. If a translation is missing, the platform shows the German version.
list.caption: Pages by kind, slug and language
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No pages} one {One page} other {# pages}}
list.emptyDescription: Create the first page, for example a help article.
list.noMatchDescription: No page matches kind and language. Reset the filter.

editor.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Help appears under /help/<slug>.
editor.summaryHint: One sentence for the help list and the preview.
editor.bodyTabs: Write the text or see the preview
editor.bodyHint: Markdown without HTML: # Heading, - list, 1. list, **bold**, *italic*, [link](/en/help). Empty line for a new paragraph.
editor.metaIntro: Without input, title and summary apply.
editor.publishNowHint: Without a tick the page stays a draft and is not public.
editor.liveText: Saving changes it publicly at once. To check first, unpublish it beforehand.
editor.savedPublished: The page is created and published.
editor.savedLive: The page is saved and changed publicly.

page.newIntro: New pages are drafts until you publish them.
page.unpublished: The page is unpublished and no longer public.
page.deleteLive: The page is published and disappears at once. Its address then returns a 404. This cannot be undone.
page.deleteDraft: The draft is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
page.noTranslations: This page only exists in this language.

seo.title: SEO
seo.intro: Title, description and indexing for single paths, for example landing pages. An entry applies to one path in one language.
seo.formIntro: Saving with the same path and language replaces the entry.
seo.pathHint: With language, without domain, for example /en/ch/zuerich.
seo.noindexHint: Search engines do not include the path in their results.
seo.caption: Entries by path
seo.deleteText: Afterwards the page’s own title and description apply again.
seo.emptyDescription: Without an entry the page’s title and description apply. Create an entry above to replace them for a path.
